notes.loopType: Mandatory. ISA first-letter inference fails on UNS-style tag names, and the UNKNOWN profile disables geometry-based diagnosis (prior 0.0).
notes.peerLinks: Create asset relationships, then onboard (or republish evidence). Without peer links G13 stays NOT_EVALUATED and the disturbance soft-block cannot fire.
notes.vp: Optional. Without a VP role, G14 caps confidence at 0.89 and no diagnosis can reach CONFIRMED.
